[[Ryver Mossplanter]] is a [[Warden]] [[boss]] that can be encountered during the [[Arborstone]] mission, as well as in the [[Arborstone (explorable area)|Arborstone explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[Echovald Forest]]
** {{NPC location|Arborstone|explorable area}} (not during [[Song and Stone]] and [[Wardens On the March]])

== Missions ==
* Echovald Forest
** {{NPC location|Arborstone}}

== Skills ==
13 [[Wilderness Survival]]
* {{skill icon|Barbed Trap}}
* {{skill icon|Brambles}}
* {{skill icon|Lacerate}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Splinter Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Fur Square]]
* [[Ryver's Shortbow]] ([[unique]])
* [[Sapphire]]
* [[Tanned Hide Square]]
* [[Warden Horn]]

== Notes ==
* Does not always appear in the Arborstone mission. It shares its one possible [[spawn]] point with [[Milefaun Mindflayer]].
* Does not always appear if the quest [[Song and Stone]] is active.
